summary: Reads the next byte from a buffered I/O context. Decrements the remaining-count dword at this+4; when the decremented count is negative (buffer exhausted), calls sub_58C255(this) to refill and returns its result. Otherwise returns the byte at the cursor pointer stored at this+0 and advances that pointer.

operations.description: Decrement the remaining-byte-count dword at this+4.
When the decremented count is negative (buffer exhausted), call sub_58C255(this) to refill and return its result.
Return the byte at the current cursor pointer (dword at this+0) and advance the cursor pointer by one.

unresolved: sub_58C255 refill semantics and whether its return encodes EOF are not established here.
Owner of the buffered I/O object and the meaning of cursor/count fields are unknown.
Legacy ABI label Buffered_Byte_Reader is not an owner name.
